fig1_quadrature_variances.svg: Quadrature variances of the squeezed vacuum vs squeeze $r$: dots are computed by quadrature_variances(squeezed_vacuum(r)), curves the closed forms $\mathrm{Var}\,X_1=\tfrac14 e^{-2r}$ (below the vacuum/SQL line $\tfrac14$) and $\mathrm{Var}\,X_2=\tfrac14 e^{+2r}$. Their product stays pinned at $\tfrac1{16}$ — a minimum-uncertainty state for every $r$.
fig2_photon_distribution.svg: Photon-number distribution $P(n)$ of the squeezed vacuum from photon_distribution(squeezed_vacuum(r)) for $r=0.6,1.1$. Built from $a^2$, $S(\xi)$ makes photons in pairs, so only EVEN $n$ are populated (odd-$n$ vanish to machine precision); the mean rises as $\langle n\rangle=\sinh^2 r$.
